topic: resole a pair of worn-through shoes
core_question: How do I fix shoes whose outsoles are worn all the way through? (secondary: How do I get rid of fleas on my cat?)
answer_summary: Bring the shoes to a cobbler, who removes the worn-out outsole and attaches a completely new sole, restoring tread and cushioning.; after the topic shift: Apply a vet-recommended topical or oral flea preventive to the cat, comb through with a fine flea comb, and wash bedding and vacuum the home to eliminate fleas and eggs in the environment.
